--- js/worker-legacy.js:1336 ---
01322: 
01323: /* ── プログラム全体の索引（1 パスで作る） ───────────────────
01324:  *
01325:  * このツールの土台。セクションを 1 回だけ舐めて、
01326:  *
01327:  *   1. どの命令がどこを呼んでいるか（bl の辺）      → 呼び出しグラフ
01328:  *   2. どの命令がどのアドレスを指しているか          → 文字列・データの参照元
01329:  *   3. 語ごとの命令の種類                            → 関数ごとの統計（掛け算・store…）
01330:  *
01331:  * をまとめて取る。これがあると「文字列が近くにあるから関係ありそう」ではなく
01332:  * 「この関数がこの文字列を参照し、この関数から呼ばれている」と言えるようになる。
01333:  *
01334:  * Capstone は通さない。逆アセンブルより桁違いに速いので、数十 MB でも一気に走る。
01335:  */
01336: async function scanProgram({ regionId, requestId, epoch, callLimit, refLimit, kindLimit }) {
01337:   const region = regions.get(regionId);
01338:   if (!region) throw new Error('Unknown region.');
01339:   const total = Number(region.size);
01340:   const words = Math.floor(total / 4);
01341:   const capOf=(value,hard)=>value==null?hard:Math.max(0,Math.min(hard,Math.floor(Number(value)||0)));
01342:   const callCap=capOf(callLimit,MAX_EDGES), refCap=capOf(refLimit,MAX_REFS), kindCap=capOf(kindLimit,MAX_KIND_WORDS);
01343: 
01344:   const callInitial = Math.min(words, EDGES_INITIAL, callCap);
01345:   const refInitial = Math.min(words, EDGES_INITIAL, refCap);

00341: function installDemandQueryAPI(app, recognitionVersion) {
00342:   const base = createBaseQueryAdapter(app); const regionScans = new Map();
00343:   const scanRegion = async (region, options = {}, localCount = 1) => {
00344:     const epoch = Number(app?.backend?.gen ?? app?.analysisEpoch ?? 0); const key = `${epoch}:${region.id}`; let entry = regionScans.get(key);
00345:     if (!entry) {
00346:       const request = app.backend.scanProgram(region.id, options.onProgress, regionScanLimits(localCount)); entry = { request, promise:null, settled:false, waiters:0 };
00347:       entry.promise = Promise.resolve(request).then((scan) => { if (!scan || scan.cancelled) throw Object.assign(new Error('program scan cancelled'), { name:'AbortError' }); entry.settled = true; return scan; }).catch((error) => { regionScans.delete(key); throw error; });
00348:       regionScans.set(key, entry); pruneCache(regionScans);
00349:     }
00350:     return waitForShared(entry, options.signal ?? null);
00351:   };

00354:     const allRegions = executableRegions(app); const target = regionForAddress(app, address); const current = storeValue(app, 'currentRegion');
00355:     const currentExec = current?.exec === true && BigInt(current?.size ?? 0) > 0n ? current : null;
00356:     const local = kind === 'callees' ? dedupeRegions([target].filter(Boolean)) : dedupeRegions([target, currentExec].filter(Boolean));
00357:     if (!local.length) return { program:null, reason:'program-region-unavailable' };
00358:     const scans = []; for (const region of local) scans.push(await scanRegion(region, options, local.length)); abortIfNeeded(options.signal);
00359:     const unscanned = allRegions.filter((region) => !local.some((item) => item.id === region.id));
00360:     const reasons = unscanned.map((region) => `program-region-unscanned:${region.id}`);
00361:     const merged = mergeProgramScans(scans, { regions:allRegions, reasons, limits:PROGRAM_MERGE_LIMITS });
00362:     return { program:new ProgramIndex(merged, app.symbols, target ?? local[0]), reason:reasons[0] ?? null };
00363:   };

00120: 
00121: /* ── Backend と同じ形の入口 ──────────────────────────────────── */
00122: 
00123: export class NodeBackend {
00124:   constructor() { this.file = null; }
00125:   open(f) { this.file = f; return call('open', { file: f }); }
00126:   analyze(sliceIndex) {
00127:     const file = this.file;
00128:     return call('analyze', { sliceIndex })
00129:       .then((res) => augmentAnalysisResultWithChainedImports(file, sliceIndex, res));
00130:   }
00131:   guessFunctions(regionId, limit) { return call('guessFunctions', { regionId, limit }); }
00132:   scanProgram(regionId) { return call('scanProgram', { regionId }); }
00133:   fieldAccess(params) { return call('fieldAccess', params); }
00134:   valueShapes(regionId) { return call('valueShapes', { regionId }); }
00135:   fieldAccessMany(regionId, offsets) {
00136:     return call('fieldAccess', { regionId, offsets }).then((res) => {
00137:       const out = new Map();
00138:       const groups = (res && res.groups) || {};
00139:       for (const k of Object.keys(groups)) out.set(k, groups[k]);
00140:       return out;
00141:     });
00142:   }
00143:   strings(params) { return call('strings', params); }
00144:   xrefs(params) { return call('xrefs', params); }
00145:   readAt(addr, len, text) { return call('readAt', { addr, len, text }); }
00146:   fetchChunk(regionId, chunk, wantAsm) {

01147:   async ensureRecognition(options={}) {
01148:     const sym=this.symbols;
01149:     if(!sym || sym===EMPTY_INDEX) return null;
01150:     if(this.recognition && this.recognition.gen===sym.gen) return this.recognition;
01151:     if(this.recognitionBusy) return this.recognitionBusy;
01152:     const epoch=this.backend.gen;
01153:     const max=Math.min(500000,Math.max(1000,Number(options.maxFunctions)||350000));
01154:     const knowledgeLimit=Math.min(2048,Math.max(0,Number(options.knowledgeLimit ?? 512)));
01155:     const pending=(async()=>{
01156:       try { await this.ensureSwift(); } catch { /* Swift metadata is optional */ }
01157:       if(epoch!==this.backend.gen || sym!==this.symbols) return null;
01158:       const total=sym?.addrs?.length||0, count=Math.min(total,max), functions=new Array(count);
01159:       for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
01160:         if(epoch!==this.backend.gen || sym!==this.symbols) return null;
01161:         const address=sym.addrs[i], name=sym.names?.[i]||null;
01162:         const next=i+1<total?sym.addrs[i+1]:null;
01163:         const owner=this.fields?.ownerOf?.(address)||null;
01164:         const swiftName=name&&/^(.*)::method_(\d+)$/.exec(name);
01165:         functions[i]={
01166:           address,name,size:next!=null&&next>address?Number(next-address):0,
01167:           objc:owner?.className?{class:owner.className}:{},
01168:           swift:swiftName?{typeDescriptor:swiftName[1]}:{},
01169:           strings:[],calls:[],imports:[],semantic:{writes:[],thresholds:[]},fieldAccessShape:[],
01170:         };
01171:         if((i&8191)===8191) await Promise.resolve();
01172:       }
01173:       const ranked=rankApplicationFunctions(functions,()=>({notKnownVendor:true}));
01174:       const knowledgeCount=Math.min(knowledgeLimit,ranked.length);

01024:   /**
01025:    * Objective-C のクラス表を読む。このツールでいちばん効く一手。
01026:    *
01027:    * 配布用のアプリは自作の関数名が削ってあるが、Objective-C のクラスだけは
01028:    *
01029:    *   - クラス名とメソッド名（実装アドレスつき）

01033:    * -[LoginViewController loginButtonTapped:] に戻り、後者で
01034:    * [x0, #0x20] が self.hp に戻る。「どれがどの処理か」に答えられるのはここ。
01035:    *
01036:    * 裏で走らせて、できたところで画面を差し替える。失敗しても表示は続く。
01037:    */

00464: /** app からエミュレータを作る（画面側でも使う）。 */
00465: export function makeEmulator(app) {
00466:   // Legacy callers predate architecture metadata and were ARM64-only. Keep that
00467:   // compatibility path, while explicit unknown/foreign architectures fail closed.
00468:   const detectedArchitecture = app.store.get('architecture') || app.currentSlice?.()?.capability?.architecture;
00469:   const architecture = String(detectedArchitecture || 'arm64').toLowerCase();
00470:   const adapter = architectureAdapter(architecture);
00471:   if (adapter.id !== 'arm64') throw new UnsupportedArchitectureError('emulate', architecture);
00472:   const regions = (app.store.get('regions') || []).filter((r) => r.exec && r.size > 0n);
00473:   const regionAt = (addr) => regions.find((r) => addr >= r.vmAddr && addr < r.vmAddr + r.size) || null;
00474:   return new Emulator({
00475:     read: (addr, len) => app.backend.readAt(addr, len)
00476:       .then((r) => (r && r.found ? r.bytes : null)).catch(() => null),
00477:     fetch: async (addr) => {
00478:       const r = regionAt(addr);
00479:       if (!r) return null;
00480:       const row = adapter.rowForAddress(r, addr);
00481:       if (row == null) return null;
00482:       const chunk = Math.floor(row / 1024);
00483:       const e = await app.backend.fetchChunk(r.id, chunk, true);
00484:       const k = row - chunk * 1024;
00485:       return { mn: e.mn ? e.mn[k] : '', ops: e.ops ? e.ops[k] : '' };
00486:     },
00487:     isExecutable: (addr) => !!regionAt(addr),
00488:     symbolFor: (addr) => app.symbols.nameAt(addr),
00489:     labelFor: (addr) => app.symbols.label(addr),
00490:   });
00491: }

00494: function format(v) {
00495:   if (v == null) return String(v);
00496:   if (typeof v === 'bigint') return '0x' + v.toString(16).toUpperCase();
00497:   if (typeof v === 'string') return v;
00498:   if (v instanceof Uint8Array) {
00499:     return Array.from(v.slice(0, 64)).map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join(' ') +
00500:       (v.length > 64 ? ' …' : '');
00501:   }
00502:   if (Array.isArray(v)) return '[' + v.slice(0, 20).map(format).join(', ') + (v.length > 20 ? ', …' : '') + ']';

00073: /**
00074:  * Build the narrow I/O surface consumed by the deterministic function sandbox.
00075:  * This deliberately mirrors the proven emulator I/O path without exposing the
00076:  * whole App object to runtime adapters.
00077:  */
00078: export function createAppRuntimeIO(app) {
00079:   const regions = (app?.store?.get?.('regions') || []).filter((r) => r.exec && r.size > 0n);
00080:   const regionAt = (addr) => regions.find((r) => addr >= r.vmAddr && addr < r.vmAddr + r.size) || null;
00081:   return {
00082:     read: (addr, len) => app.backend.readAt(addr, len)
00083:       .then((r) => (r && r.found ? r.bytes : null)).catch(() => null),
00084:     fetch: async (addr) => {
00085:       const region = regionAt(addr);
00086:       if (!region) return null;
00087:       // The local concrete sandbox is ARM64 today. Resolve architecture from
00088:       // the same active-slice truth as the runtime identity and fail closed for
00089:       // unknown or variable-width targets instead of defaulting to ARM64.
00090:       const arch = activeArchitecture(app);
00091:       if (!localSandboxSupportsArchitecture(arch)) return null;
00092:       const row = Number((addr - region.vmAddr) / 4n);
00093:       const chunk = Math.floor(row / 1024);
00094:       const decoded = await app.backend.fetchChunk(region.id, chunk, true);
00095:       const index = row - chunk * 1024;
00096:       return { mn: decoded.mn ? decoded.mn[index] : '', ops: decoded.ops ? decoded.ops[index] : '' };
00097:     },
00098:     isExecutable: (addr) => !!regionAt(addr),
00099:     symbolFor: (addr) => app.symbols?.nameAt?.(addr) || null,
00100:     labelFor: (addr) => app.symbols?.label?.(addr) || null,
00101:   };
00102: }

00152: function beats(next, current) {
00153:   if (!next?.top) return false;
00154:   if (!current?.top) return true;
00155:   const rank = verdictRank(next.verdict) - verdictRank(current.verdict);

00157:   return Number(next.top?.fusion?.probability || 0) > Number(current.top?.fusion?.probability || 0);
00158: }

00050: function openFunction(app, sheet, address) {
00051:   if (address == null) return;
00052:   sheet.close();

00054:   else app.goToAddress?.(BigInt(address), { announce:true });
00055: }
00056: 
00057: export function showCandidates(app, goal) {
00058:   if (!goal) return null;
00059:   app.lastGoal = goal;
00060:   const controller = new AbortController();
00061:   const sheet = new Sheet(goalLabel(goal), { onClose:() => controller.abort('candidate-sheet-closed') });
00062:   const progress = progressView(sheet.body);
00063:   const host = el('div'); sheet.body.append(host);
00064: 
00065:   investigationServiceFor(app).investigate(goal, {
00066:     signal:controller.signal,
00067:     onProgress:(value) => progress.update(value),
00068:   }).then((result) => {
00069:     progress.done();
00070:     if (controller.signal.aborted || !sheet.root.isConnected) return;
00071:     appendCompleteness(host, result);
00072:     const pin = result.pin;
00073:     if (pin?.top && pin.verdict !== VERDICT.NONE) {
00074:       const answer = el('section', 'answer-summary');
00075:       answer.append(el('h3', null, pick('最も強い答え', 'Strongest answer')));
00076:       const address = pin.top.addr ?? pin.top.function ?? pin.top.address ?? null;
00077:       const title = pin.top.name || (address != null ? functionLabel(app, address) : pin.top.field?.name) || goalLabel(goal);
00078:       answer.append(el('div', 'fn-name', String(title)));
00079:       answer.append(el('div', 'hint', verdictLabel(pin.verdict)));
00080:       if (address != null) {
00081:         answer.append(tapRow(pick('この処理を開く', 'Open this routine'), {
00082:           sub:addrHex(BigInt(address)), right:'›', onTap:() => openFunction(app, sheet, address),
00083:         }));
00084:       }

00118: function rememberQuery(query) {
00119:   const q = String(query || '').trim();
00120:   if (!q) return;
00121:   const next = [q, ...recentQueries().filter((x) => x !== q)].slice(0, 6);
00122:   try { sessionStorage.setItem('hex.ui.recentQueries', JSON.stringify(next)); } catch { /* private mode */ }
00123: }

00126:  * Canonical Investigate no longer opens the legacy question sheet and then
00127:  * searches its DOM for an input to fake an Enter key. The Goal Compiler is the
00128:  * domain boundary; only the candidate presentation remains a compatibility Sheet.
00129:  */
00130: function runInvestigation(app, query) {
00131:   return requireFile(app, () => {
00132:     try {
00133:       const compiled = compileGoal(String(query || '').trim());
00134:       const goal = compiled?.goal;
00135:       if (!goal) {
00136:         const missing = Array.isArray(compiled?.missing) && compiled.missing.length ? ' ' + compiled.missing.join(' / ') : '';
00137:         toast(text('質問を解析できませんでした。対象や動作をもう少し具体的に書いてください。', 'Could not compile that question. Describe the target or action more specifically.') + missing);
00138:         return null;
00139:       }
00140:       return showCandidates(app, { ...goal, query: compiled });
00141:     } catch (error) {
00142:       toast(text('質問の解析に失敗しました。', 'Question compilation failed.') + ' ' + String(error?.message || error));
00143:       return null;
00144:     }
00145:   });
00146: }

00212: function lowerBoundBigInt(array, value) {
00213:   let lo = 0, hi = array.length;
00214:   while (lo < hi) {
00215:     const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1;
00216:     if (array[mid] < value) lo = mid + 1; else hi = mid;
00217:   }
00218:   return lo;
00219: }

00066: /**
00067:  * Replace the compatibility BinaryId wrapper with one producer per file/epoch.
00068:  * Consumer cancellation only detaches that waiter; the platform-worker hash is
00069:  * cancelled when the last waiter leaves. Durable callers still receive the exact
00070:  * full-content digest and stale file/epoch publication remains fail-closed.
00071:  */

00073:   const backend = app?.backend;
00074:   if (!backend || typeof backend.ensureContentHash !== 'function') return null;

00077:   backend.ensureBinaryId = function ensureSharedBinaryId(options = {}) {
00078:     if (this.binaryId) return Promise.resolve(this.binaryId);
00079:     if (!this.file) return Promise.reject(new Error('binary-id-file-unavailable'));
00080: 
00081:     const file = this.file;
00082:     const epoch = Number(this.gen ?? this.analysisEpoch ?? 0);
00083:     if (current && (current.file !== file || current.epoch !== epoch)) {
00084:       if (!current.settled) current.controller.abort('binary-identity-binding-changed');
00085:       current = null;
00086:       this._binaryIdPromise = null;
00087:     }
00088: 
00089:     if (!current) {
00090:       const controller = new AbortController();
00091:       const entry = {
00092:         file, epoch, controller, waiters:0, settled:false, promise:null,
00093:       };
00094:       entry.promise = scheduleBackground(controller.signal)
00095:         .then(() => this.ensureContentHash(options.onProgress, controller.signal))
00096:         .then((hash) => {
00097:           abortIfNeeded(controller.signal);
00098:           if (this.file !== file || Number(this.gen ?? this.analysisEpoch ?? 0) !== epoch) {
00099:             const error = new Error('stale binary identity');
00100:             error.stale = true;
00101:             throw error;
00102:           }
00103:           const binaryId = createBinaryIdFromDigest(hash);
00104:           this.binaryId = binaryId;

00109:           if (current === entry) {
00110:             current = null;
00111:             this._binaryIdPromise = null;
00112:           }
00113:           throw error;
00114:         });
00115:       current = entry;
00116:       this._binaryIdPromise = entry.promise;

00704:   async ensureBinaryId(options = {}) {
00705:     if (this.binaryId) return this.binaryId;
00706:     if (!this.file) throw new Error('binary-id-file-unavailable');
00707:     const file = this.file;
00708:     if (!this._binaryIdPromise) {
00709:       this._binaryIdPromise = sha256BlobHex(file, {
00710:         chunkBytes:options.chunkBytes,
00711:         signal:options.signal ?? null,
00712:         onProgress:options.onProgress,
00713:       }).then((result) => {
00714:         if (this.file !== file) throw new StaleRequestError();
00715:         const binaryId = createBinaryIdFromDigest(result.hex);
00716:         this.binaryId = binaryId;
00717:         return binaryId;
00718:       }).catch((error) => {
00719:         this._binaryIdPromise = null;
00720:         throw error;
00721:       });
00722:     }
00723:     return this._binaryIdPromise;
00724:   }

00114: 
00115: export async function sha256BlobHex(blob, options = {}) {
00116:   if (!blob || !Number.isSafeInteger(blob.size) || blob.size < 0 || typeof blob.slice !== 'function') throw new TypeError('sha256 source must be a Blob/File-like object with a safe integer size');
00117:   const chunkBytes = options.chunkBytes ?? 1024 * 1024;
00118:   if (!Number.isSafeInteger(chunkBytes) || chunkBytes <= 0) throw new TypeError('chunkBytes must be a positive safe integer');
00119:   const signal = options.signal ?? null;
00120:   const hash = new IncrementalSha256();
00121:   let reads = 0, bytesRead = 0, largestRead = 0;
00122:   for (let offset = 0; offset < blob.size; offset += chunkBytes) {
00123:     throwIfAborted(signal);
00124:     const end = Math.min(blob.size, offset + chunkBytes);
00125:     const part = blob.slice(offset, end);
00126:     if (!part || typeof part.arrayBuffer !== 'function') throw new TypeError('sha256 source slices must provide arrayBuffer()');
00127:     const bytes = new Uint8Array(await part.arrayBuffer());
00128:     throwIfAborted(signal);
00129:     if (bytes.byteLength !== end - offset) throw new Error(`sha256 truncated read: expected ${end - offset}, received ${bytes.byteLength}`);
00130:     hash.update(bytes);
00131:     reads++;
00132:     bytesRead += bytes.byteLength;
00133:     largestRead = Math.max(largestRead, bytes.byteLength);
00134:     options.onProgress?.({ bytesRead, totalBytes:blob.size, reads });
00135:   }
00136:   throwIfAborted(signal);
00137:   return Object.freeze({ hex:hash.hexDigest(), bytesRead, reads, largestRead, chunkBytes });
00138: }

00500:   assert.throws(() => regionSize('   '), RangeError);
00501:   assert.equal(regionSize(0), 0n);
00502:   assert.equal(regionSize('0'), 0n);
00503:   console.log('  ok #1086 / #1088 worker validation rejects malformed scalars');
00504: }

00065: 
00066: /**
00067:  * Replace the compatibility BinaryId wrapper with one producer per file/epoch.
00068:  * Consumer cancellation only detaches that waiter; the platform-worker hash is
00069:  * cancelled when the last waiter leaves. Durable callers still receive the exact
00070:  * full-content digest and stale file/epoch publication remains fail-closed.
00071:  */
00072: export function installSharedWorkerBinaryIdentity(app) {
00073:   const backend = app?.backend;
00074:   if (!backend || typeof backend.ensureContentHash !== 'function') return null;
00075: 
00076:   let current = null;
00077:   backend.ensureBinaryId = function ensureSharedBinaryId(options = {}) {
00078:     if (this.binaryId) return Promise.resolve(this.binaryId);
00079:     if (!this.file) return Promise.reject(new Error('binary-id-file-unavailable'));
00080: 
00081:     const file = this.file;
00082:     const epoch = Number(this.gen ?? this.analysisEpoch ?? 0);
00083:     if (current && (current.file !== file || current.epoch !== epoch)) {
00084:       if (!current.settled) current.controller.abort('binary-identity-binding-changed');
00085:       current = null;
00086:       this._binaryIdPromise = null;
00087:     }
00088: 
00089:     if (!current) {

01089:     const epoch = this.backend.gen;
01090:     if (this.swiftModel && this.swiftRuntime) return this.swiftModel;
01091:     if (this.swiftBusy && this.swiftBusyEpoch === epoch) return this.swiftBusy;

01095:     this.swiftBusyAbort?.abort('swift-slice-superseded');
01096:     const controller = new AbortController();

01098:     this.swiftBusyEpoch = epoch;
01099:     this.swiftBusy = (async () => {
01100:       const read = (addr, len) => this.backend.readAt(addr, len, false, { priority:'background' })
01101:         .then((r) => (r && r.found ? r.bytes : null)).catch(() => null);
01102:       try {
01103:         const model=await buildSwiftMetadataModel(read,regions,{
01104:           budget:20000,
01105:           signal:controller.signal,
01106:           resolvePointer:(raw,context)=>this.backend.resolvePointer(raw,{...context,sliceIndex:slice}),
01107:         });

01109:         this.swiftModel = model; this.swiftRuntime = buildSwiftRuntimeIndex(model);
01110:         const exec = this.executableRegions(); const names = [];
01111:         for (const type of model?.types || []) for (const method of type.methods || type.vtable || []) {
01112:           if (method?.impl != null && exec.some((r) => method.impl >= r.vmAddr && method.impl < r.vmAddr + r.size)) names.push({ addr: method.impl, name: `${type.name || 'SwiftType'}::method_${method.index}`, source: 'swift-metadata' });

01114:         if (names.length) { this.symbols.addNames(names); this.symbols.addFunctions(names.map((x) => x.addr)); this.viewer.setSymbols(this.symbols); }
01115:         return model;
01116:       } catch { return null; }
01117:       finally {
01118:         if (this.swiftBusyEpoch === epoch) { this.swiftBusy = null; this.swiftBusyEpoch = -1; }
01119:         if (this.swiftBusyAbort === controller) { this.swiftBusyAbort = null; }
01120:       }
01121:     })();
01122:     return this.swiftBusy;
01123:   }

00030: function cooperativeYield() { return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 0)); }
00031: async function waitForForegroundDrain(epoch) {
00032:   // Background metadata performs many small paged reads. Do not enqueue the
00033:   // next page while any interactive request for the same binary epoch is live.
00034:   // A currently executing page is bounded, so foreground work is never held
00035:   // behind an unbounded metadata scan.
00036:   while ([...active.values()].some((entry) => entry.epoch === epoch && entry.priority !== 'background')) {
00037:     await cooperativeYield();
00038:   }
00039: }

00041: self.onmessage = async (event) => {
00042:   const msg = event.data;
00043:   if (!msg || typeof msg.t !== 'string') return;
00044:   if (msg.t === 'cancel') {
00045:     for (const entry of active.values()) {
00046:       if ((msg.requestId == null || msg.requestId === entry.id) && (msg.epoch == null || msg.epoch === entry.epoch)) entry.controller.abort();
00047:     }
00048:     return;
00049:   }
00050:   const serialized = msg.t === 'open' || msg.t === 'detect';
00051:   if (serialized) {
00052:     currentEpoch = msg.epoch;
00053:     for (const entry of active.values()) if (entry.epoch !== currentEpoch) entry.controller.abort();
00054:   }

00134:       await runOne(rest[index]);
00135:     }
00136:   });

00172: function randomToken(size) { const bytes = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(size)); return b64(bytes); }
00173: function b64(bytes) { let binary = ''; for (const value of bytes) binary += String.fromCharCode(value); return btoa(binary).replaceAll('+', '-').replaceAll('/', '_').replace(/=+$/g, ''); }

00517: /* The frame is kept off-screen instead of `display:none`: a non-rendered iframe
00518:    is not laid out, and ChatGPT then never mounts the composer the Worker drives. */
00519: export function defaultCreateFrame({ slot, documentRef = globalThis.document } = {}) {
00520:   const doc = documentRef;
00521:   if (!doc?.createElement || !doc.documentElement) return null;
00522:   const host = ensureFrameHost(doc);
00523:   const frame = doc.createElement('iframe');
00524:   frame.id = `hex-dev-worker-frame-${slot}`;
00525:   frame.title = `Hex Dev Worker ${slot}`;
00526:   frame.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
00527:   frame.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
00528:   frame.style.cssText = `width:${FRAME_WIDTH}px;height:${FRAME_HEIGHT}px;border:0;background:#fff;`;
00529:   host.append(frame);
00530:   return {
00531:     frame,
00532:     async navigate(href) { frame.src = href; },
00533:     close() {
00534:       try { frame.remove(); } catch { /* already detached */ }
00535:       try { if (!host.querySelector?.('iframe')) host.remove(); } catch { /* already detached */ }
00536:     },
00537:   };
00538: }

00540: export function defaultCreateWorkerRuntime({ slot, frame, document, now = () => new Date().toISOString() } = {}) {
00541:   const view = frame?.contentWindow || document?.defaultView || null;
00542:   const adapter = new ChatGPTDOMAdapter({
00543:     document,
00544:     view,
00545:     location: view?.location || document?.location || null,
00546:     history: view?.history || null,
00547:   });
00548:   const controller = new WorkerChatController({ adapter, document, now });
00549:   const node = createTabNode({ role: TAB_NODE_ROLE.WORKER, now });
00550:   const coordinator = new DedicatedWorkerCoordinator({ controller, tabNodeId: node.tabNodeId, now });
00551:   return {
00552:     slot, adapter, controller, coordinator, node,
00553:     ready() { try { return !!adapter.composer(); } catch { return false; } },
00554:     close() { try { coordinator.close(); } catch { /* already closed */ } },
00555:   };

00047:   abortIfNeeded(signal);
00048:   const priority = priorityOf(options);
00049:   if (globalThis.scheduler?.postTask) {
00050:     return globalThis.scheduler.postTask(() => undefined, { priority, signal:signal ?? undefined });

00053:     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
00054:       let settled = false;
00055:       const finish = (fn, value) => {
00056:         if (settled) return;
00057:         settled = true;
00058:         signal?.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
00059:         fn(value);
00060:       };
00061:       const onAbort = () => finish(reject, abortError(signal));
00062:       signal?.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once:true });
00063:       requestIdleCallback(() => finish(resolve), { timeout:250 });
00064:     });
00065:   }
00066:   return Promise.resolve();
00067: }
00068: function boundedBudget(value, fallback) {
00069:   const number = Number(value);
00070:   if (!Number.isFinite(number) || number < 0) return fallback;
00071:   return Math.min(fallback, Math.floor(number));
00072: }

00075:   if (!override || typeof override !== 'object') return defaults;
00076:   const out = { ...defaults };

00142:     };
00143:     const onAbort = () => finish(reject, abortError(signal, 'Binary identity scheduling aborted'));

00146:       requestIdleCallback(() => finish(resolve), { timeout:250 });
00147:     } else {
00148:       setTimeout(() => finish(resolve), 0);
00149:     }

00165:       }).catch((error) => { this._binaryIdPromise = null; throw error; });

00196: function functionsFromSymbols(symbols,limit=MAX_DIFF_FUNCTIONS){
00197:   const funcs=symbols?.funcs||[];const out=[];const n=Math.min(funcs.length,limit);

00201:   }
00202:   out.complete=n===funcs.length && symbols?.functionStartsComplete===true;
00203:   out.total=funcs.length;out.scanned=n;out.truncationReason=n<funcs.length?'function-budget':symbols?.functionStartsComplete===true?null:'function-discovery-incomplete';
00204:   return out;
00205: }

00697:   async ensureShapes(onProgress) {
00698:     if (this.shapes) return this.shapes;
00699:     const epoch = this.backend.gen;
00700:     if (this.shapesBusy && this.shapesBusyEpoch === epoch) return this.shapesBusy;

00702:     if (!region) return null;

00707:           onProgress && ((p) => onProgress({ phase: 'shapes', done: p.done, all: p.all })));

00709:       } catch {
00710:         if (epoch === this.backend.gen) this.shapes = null;
00711:       } finally {
00712:         if (this.shapesBusyEpoch === epoch) {
00713:           this.shapesBusy = null;
00714:           this.shapesBusyEpoch = -1;
00715:         }
00716:       }
00717:       return epoch === this.backend.gen ? this.shapes : null;
00718:     })();
00719:     return this.shapesBusy;
00720:   }

00152: /**
00153:  * Bind the scheduler's cancellation signal to the existing worker request.
00154:  * The worker remains the only semantic producer; cancellation only controls
00155:  * whether its result is accepted/published.
00156:  */
00157: export function awaitCancellableProducer(operation, signal) {
00158:   const promise = Promise.resolve(operation);
00159:   if (!signal) return promise;
00160: 
00161:   let cancelled = false;
00162:   const cancelProducer = () => {
00163:     if (cancelled) return;
00164:     cancelled = true;
00165:     try { operation?.cancel?.(); } catch { /* cancellation reason remains authoritative */ }
00166:   };
00167: 
00168:   if (signal.aborted) {
00169:     cancelProducer();
00170:     return Promise.reject(abortError(signal));
00171:   }
00172: 
00173:   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
00174:     let settled = false;
00175:     const finish = (fn, value) => {
00176:       if (settled) return;
00177:       settled = true;
00178:       signal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
00179:       fn(value);
00180:     };
00181:     const onAbort = () => {
00182:       cancelProducer();
00183:       finish(reject, abortError(signal));
00184:     };
